name: Orthofix Medical Inc.
business_overview: Orthofix Medical Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a medical technology company in the United States, Italy, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Brazil, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Global Spine and Global Limb Reconstruction. The Global Spine segment manufactures, distributes, and provides support services for bone growth stimulation devices that enhance bone fusion; designs, develops, and markets a portfolio of spine fixation implant products for use throughout the spinal column; and offers bone graft substitutes, such as fiber-based and particulate demineralized bone matrices, cellular bone allografts, collagen ceramic matrices, and synthetic bone void fillers in various forms with supporting graft delivery solutions to treat various spinal, orthopedic, and dental conditions. This segment also designs, develops, and markets a portfolio of navigation technologies, including tracked surgical tools, intelligent software, and imaging equipment based on machine-vision and optical innovations; and 7D FLASH Navigation System, a navigation platform for spinal and cranial procedures. The Global Limb Reconstruction segment offers products and solutions for the underserved limb reconstruction market, including deformity correction, limb lengthening, complex fracture management, and limb preservation. This segment also designs, develops, and markets external and internal fixation limb reconstruction products that are coupled with enabling digital technologies to support the entire patient care continuum. It sells its products through distributors and sales representatives to hospitals, healthcare organizations, healthcare providers, ambulatory surgery centers, and out-patient hospitals. The company was formerly known as Orthofix International N.V. and changed its name to Orthofix Medical Inc. in July 2018. Orthofix Medical Inc. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Lewisville, Texas.

classification_meta.logic_summary: Orthofix Medical is a medical technology company that manufactures and distributes spine fixation implants, bone growth stimulation devices, and limb reconstruction products to healthcare providers globally.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** Orthofix is showing steady momentum in its core spine fixation and fracture businesses, supported by a realigned commercial channel strategy. The company’s top tier of spine distributor partners is delivering robust growth, indicating that recent channel restructuring actions are gaining traction. Therapeutic Solutions (BGT) continues to outperform the broader market, while fracture product demand remains solid. The underlying pro forma trends strip out noise from discontinued M6 product lines, revealing a business that is stabilizing and building forward motion despite minor calendar headwinds.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership has taken deliberate action to reshape the spine commercial channel and is now reinforcing confidence by reaffirming full-year guidance. The decision to exit underperforming product lines and sharpen focus on profitable growth signals a disciplined internal approach. The “Drive Profitable Growth” investor presentation and steady first-quarter execution suggest management is delivering on its turnaround roadmap. While earlier market sentiment may have been cautious, the narrative emerging from recent calls is one of credible execution and a stabilizing outlook under the current leadership team.
